_doc: Single source of truth for time-window presets across all experiments. Pages fetch('../shared/spans.json') for labels + ordering; prep.py scripts read it for date ranges. Convention: a prep emits data keyed by span key for whichever subset it supports; the page renders buttons only for keys present in its data JSON, in the order listed here. Event spans have fixed dates; trailing spans are relative to the data end date (prep resolves them at build time). Display convention: trailing spans render LEFT of event spans (trailing-first, since Last-1y is the default), labels are bare '1y'/'5y'/'10y'.
